exam_scheme.note: Admissions to the 250 undergraduate MBBS seats at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) — comprising 200 seats at JIPMER Puducherry campus and 50 seats at JIPMER Karaikal campus — are governed by Section 14 of the National Medical Commission (NMC) Act, 2019. JIPMER no longer conducts an independent entrance exam; admission is determined exclusively through the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate) [NEET-UG] conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA), followed by centralized All India Quota (AIQ) online counselling administered by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC), Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). The NEET-UG examination comprises 200 multiple-choice questions across Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Botany & Zoology) carrying 720 marks, with 4 marks for each correct answer and negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect response.
